simple.meaning: מִרְשַׁעַת (mirshaʻath) is a Hebrew word meaning “a female wicked doer.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִרְשַׁעַת (H4849) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִרְשַׁעַת (H4849) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מִרְשַׁעַת (mirshaʻath) / H4849 is traced through 2 Chronicles 24:7 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
